summary: Iteration 18 (Upcycle + 3% commission) tested. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (settings=3%, /api/upcycle/meta, section filter, furniture_type=chair, pickup_only=4, near_lat/lng small radius 1 (Throne, distance ~1.9km), radius 20000 all 5 ascending, full upcycle create+cleanup, delivery=['bogus'] coerced to ['ships'], invalid section/furniture_type -> 422, event analytics platform_fee == 3% of revenue_gross). Frontend: /upcycle hero, stat tiles, 3% copy, 5 upcycle cards, chip filters (lamp -> 1, back to 5), pickup-only -> 4 (Koi Lantern excluded), sort price_asc puts Koi Lantern $320 first, Ships badge on Koi, Pickup badges on others, before-after-toggle toggles labels without navigation, card link -> /artwork/{id}, detail page shows upcycle-badge ('UPCYCLE · LAMP' / 'UPCYCLE · CHAIR'), pickup-badge ('LOCAL PICKUP · BROOKLYN, NY'), before-after-toggle, and materials in spec line. Mobile 390x844: scrollWidth==390 (no horizontal scroll), toggle tappable. Upload form at /studio/upload?section=upcycle exposes art-section preselected 'upcycle' and all upcycle-fields (furniture-type, materials, delivery-ships, delivery-local_pickup, loc-city, loc-find, before-image); switching art-section back to 'art' hides upcycle-fields; deselecting both delivery toggles keeps at least one selected (ships stayed on).
action_items: Spec deviation only (no code fix needed): review request refers to '/artist?section=upcycle'; actual route is '/studio/upload?section=upcycle' (which works correctly). Consider adding a /artist redirect if you want the shorter URL to be user-facing.

Minor: POST /api/artworks requires description and images.length>=1 — the spec payload in the review request uses images:[] which yields 422. Behavior is correct per Pydantic model; just noting the spec vs code mismatch.
critical_code_review_comments: artworks.py delivery validator correctly coerces bogus values to ['ships'] and enforces membership in {ships, local_pickup} — verified.

artworks.py near_lat/near_lng path caps result to 400 pre-filter, then filters and sorts by distance_km ascending — works for the 5-piece dataset but note the 400-doc cap could bite at scale; consider using $geoNear with a 2dsphere index later.
events.py analytics uses settings.commission_percent/100 — commission change to 3% flows through everywhere (settings, admin defaults, payments.py, events analytics).
ArtworkDetail.js correctly gates upcycle-badge on art.section=='upcycle' and pickup-badge on delivery.includes('local_pickup'); Koi Lantern (ships-only) shows badge/no-pickup as expected.
Upcycle.js re-fetches on every filter change; UI shows LOADING between requests — acceptable but a subtle skeleton would feel smoother.
seed_data_creation: none — cleaned up all ITER18 artworks created during tests.
